sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_trips FROM trips;

SELECT t.driver_id, d.first_name, d.last_name, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM trips t JOIN drivers d ON t.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE t.driver_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.driver_id, d.first_name, d.last_name ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.customer_type,
 SUM(si.claim_amount) AS total_claim_amount
FROM safety_incidents si
JOIN trips t ON si.trip_id = t.trip_id
JOIN loads l ON t.load_id = l.load_id
JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_type
ORDER BY total_claim_amount DESC;
SELECT SUM(actual_distance_miles) / NULLIF(SUM(fuel_gallons_used), 0) AS overall_mpg FROM trips;

SELECT c.customer_type,
 100.0 * SUM(si.claim_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(l.revenue),0) AS safety_claims_pct
FROM loads l
JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN trips t ON l.load_id = t.load_id
LEFT JOIN safety_incidents si ON t.trip_id = si.trip_id
GROUP BY c.customer_type
ORDER BY safety_claims_pct DESC;

SELECT (COUNT(*)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(t.actual_distance_miles),0)) * 1000000 AS at_fault_accident_rate_per_million_miles
FROM safety_incidents si
JOIN trips t ON si.trip_id = t.trip_id
WHERE si.at_fault_flag = TRUE;

SELECT f.facility_type,
 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN de.detention_minutes > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_detention_over_2h
FROM delivery_events de
JOIN facilities f ON de.facility_id = f.facility_id
GROUP BY f.facility_type
ORDER BY pct_detention_over_2h DESC;

WITH maint AS (
 SELECT truck_id,
 SUM(total_cost) AS total_maint_cost
 FROM maintenance_records
 GROUP BY truck_id
), drv AS (
 SELECT truck_id,
 SUM(actual_distance_miles) AS total_miles
 FROM trips
 GROUP BY truck_id
), combined AS (
 SELECT m.truck_id,
 m.total_maint_cost,
 d.total_miles
 FROM maint m
 JOIN drv d USING (truck_id)
), make_agg AS (
 SELECT t.make,
 SUM(c.total_maint_cost) AS make_maint_cost,
 SUM(c.total_miles) AS make_miles
 FROM combined c
 JOIN trucks t ON c.truck_id = t.truck_id
 GROUP BY t.make
)
SELECT make,
 (make_maint_cost / NULLIF(make_miles,0) * 1000) AS maintenance_cost_per_1000_miles
FROM make_agg
ORDER BY maintenance_cost_per_1000_miles DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH claims AS (
 SELECT c.customer_type,
 SUM(si.claim_amount) AS total_claims
 FROM safety_incidents si
 JOIN trips t ON si.trip_id = t.trip_id
 JOIN loads l ON t.load_id = l.load_id
 JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
 GROUP BY c.customer_type
), revenue AS (
 SELECT c.customer_type,
 SUM(l.revenue) AS total_revenue
 FROM loads l
 JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
 GROUP BY c.customer_type
)
SELECT r.customer_type,
 (c.total_claims / NULLIF(r.total_revenue,0)) * 100 AS claim_percentage
FROM revenue r
JOIN claims c USING (customer_type)
ORDER BY claim_percentage DESC;

WITH ev AS (
 SELECT de.facility_id,
 CASE WHEN de.detention_minutes > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS long_detention,
 1 AS total
 FROM delivery_events de
 WHERE de.event_type = 'Delivery'
), agg AS (
 SELECT facility_id,
 SUM(long_detention) AS long_detention_cnt,
 SUM(total) AS total_cnt
 FROM ev
 GROUP BY facility_id
)
SELECT f.facility_type,
 SUM(agg.long_detention_cnt) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(agg.total_cnt),0) AS detention_percentage
FROM facilities f
JOIN agg ON f.facility_id = agg.facility_id
GROUP BY f.facility_type
ORDER BY detention_percentage DESC;

WITH total_rev AS (
 SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
 FROM loads
), top_customers AS (
 SELECT l.customer_id, SUM(l.revenue) AS customer_revenue
 FROM loads l
 GROUP BY l.customer_id
 ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC
 LIMIT 10
), top_rev AS (
 SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) AS top_revenue
 FROM top_customers
)
SELECT (top_rev.top_revenue / NULLIF(total_rev.total_revenue,0)) * 100.0 AS top_10_customers_percentage
FROM top_rev, total_rev;

WITH facility_deliveries AS (
 SELECT de.facility_id,
 SUM(CASE WHEN de.on_time_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_count,
 COUNT(*) AS total_count
 FROM delivery_events de
 WHERE de.event_type = 'Delivery'
 GROUP BY de.facility_id
 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
)
SELECT fd.facility_id,
 f.facility_name,
 (100.0 * fd.on_time_count) / NULLIF(fd.total_count,0) AS on_time_rate_pct
FROM facility_deliveries fd
JOIN facilities f ON fd.facility_id = f.facility_id
ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC
LIMIT 3;
